title: Every Software Developer Has Blamed…
why_read: A personal, conference-recap blog post with little direct technical content beyond a lighthearted developer humor list.
analysis: This piece is a casual, humorous reflection on common things developers blame for problems, like other developers or the company, written after attending a conference. It contains essentially no technical substance, code, or systems analysis. It may resonate as relatable workplace humor but offers nothing new for a technical digest reader. Low value for engineers seeking substantive technical content.
